observed_process_thread_count.reason: no process-global thread counter is collected; local worker boundaries only

configured_worker_count.reason: result has no explicit worker-budget field

observed_local_worker_count.reason: result does not create an explicit local worker team

deterministic_task_count.reason: result does not use an explicit execution context

deterministic_chunk_count.reason: result has neither an explicit execution context nor range simulation

lock_wait_ns.reason: no exact instrumented lock boundary is present; waiter counts are not timed

confidence_interval_95.method: two-sided Student's t interval for the mean

docx_section_layout.timing_scope: preparation, source-backed open, section query, columns edit, commit, and sequential publication; correctness, reopen, patch, refusal, cache, source, sink, and ZIP gates are excluded
docx_section_layout.source_observation_scope: PptxRangeSource logical requests over an immutable in-memory backing source; delegated counters are wrapper observations, not physical or network I/O

provider.source_scope: immutable OwnedSource memory backing beneath the benchmark-only PptxRangeSource; simulated range/service behavior, with no network or physical-storage claim
provider.staging_scope: filesystem staging and source hashing are outside the operation clock; range backing construction, FileSource::open (warm route), and adapter construction are inside sample preparation
provider.observation_boundary: provider counters snapshot immediately after publication and before reopen, inverse publication, semantic validation, or other verification
provider.logical_observation_scope: caller-facing positional requests accepted by FileSource wrapper or PptxRangeSource; request-size distribution is logical wrapper evidence
provider.underlying_observation_scope: ReadAt calls delegated beneath PptxRangeSource, counted before and after the wrapped call; not physical filesystem, kernel, network, or remote-service I/O
